members.title: Cora Mae Jackson
members.shortBio: Born Cora Mae Wilson in Brinkley, Arkansas. Mother of eight, grandmother of 35, great-grandmother of 39 and counting.
members.bio:
Ms. Cora Mae Jackson, born Cora Mae Wilson is a native of Brinkley, Arkansas. Cora is the mother of eight children (four boys and four girls), with 35 grandchildren and 39 greatgrandchildren. This site is to honor Ms. Cora and her commitment to her children as a dedicated mother who sacraficed to raise her children with respect and in the fear of the Lord.

Her children called her Mu. This site was built by her family to honor her and to keep every branch of the tree within reach of the next generation.

members.title: Joanne Jackson
members.bio:
I didn't just grow up.

I was taught to speak when I enter a room,

Say please & thank you, to have respect for my elders,

Lend a helping hand to those in need,

Hold the door for the person behind me,

Say excuse me when it's needed,

& to love people for who they are, not for what you can get from them! I was also taught to treat people the way I want to be treated!

members.title: Anthony Craig McMath
members.bio:
Currently I reside in Tacoma, Washington where I work as a Sales Development Manager for Comcast Cable. During my high school years I was an artist, drummer in the band, and a pretty decent student. I was a young servant leader in my church and sang in a church group call the Children of Harmony.

I joined the military in 1981 and attended basic training at Ft. Dix NJ. and Mechanical Drafting at Ft. Belvoir Virginia. I married Floscine Harris in 1982 and in 1984 went full time army stationed at Ft. Lewis Washington in 1984 after attending transportation school at Ft. Leonard Wood, MO. I completed my military career in 1987 as a transportation sergeant in the AU.S.Army.

After the military I work at an airplane parts manufacturer, then as a salesperson for Sears. Eventually I left Sears to start my own business as a portrait artist.
members.occupation: US Army, 6 years. Sales Development Manager, Comcast Cable. Portrait artist. Master’s degree, University of Phoenix.
members.shortBio: Fifth child, known as Tony and Anka. Army veteran, artist, drummer, and the builder of the original family website.

members.title: Tammie Denise McMath
members.bio: Growing up in a house with 7 siblings was never boring. All we had was our mom and one another. She always taught us to look out for one another and to be there for each other. My mother taught me the simple rules of life. She told me who God is and to always keep my focus on Him. Allowing God to work on me and listening to the teachings of my mother has made me a better person today. I learned to love in spite of, to forgive because we all make mistake and to have compassion. So now because I chose to follow the right path I am stronger, I am grateful and thankful and I am humble. I can love my enemies and do good to those who misuse me because I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me. I am who I am by the grace of God
members.shortBio: Sixth child. Mother of Joshua, Charity, and Gabrielle.

members.title: Tanya Rose Jackson
members.bio: Baby girl of the family , number seven out of eight children, mother of five sons, grandmother of 8 girls and 2 boys with more being added to the family. I obtained an associates degree in 2003, I worked my way up from a chicken leg packer in Batesville, AR. to a shift leader position at Unilever in Jonesboro, AR and was in that position for 9 years, then moved on to become a manufacturing supervisor. It was a long journey with joy and sorrow in between. Currently Graduating with a bachelor degree in business specializing in technology management.
members.occupation: Manufacturing supervisor. Associate’s degree 2003; bachelor’s in business, technology management.

stories.title: God Made Me Who I Am
stories.excerpt: God Made Me Who I Am I am fearfully and wonderfully made God made me in secret—and in me substance was laid This substance that was laid, this special feature…
stories.body:
God
Made Me Who I Am
I am fearfully and wonderfully made
God made me in secret—and in me substance was laid
This substance that was laid, this special feature
Makes me stand out from every other creature
This God-given feature—I call this ‘My Mark’
It allows me to shine even when things seem dark
My mark makes me different from ALL the rest
I have the mark that helps me to pass every test
The enemy told me that I was weak and feeble
And no one wants to listen-to you of all people
But one day while His face I did seek
The Lord said, my child, I made you unique
When I formed you, it was no mistake
I gave you a distinct mark of which you chose not to take
Look not outward but when you look deep inside
The inner strength within you, will cause you to arise
That substance—my mark—my inner strength--Just like Jesus, it is there all the time.

history.title: Roots in Brinkley, Arkansas
history.body: Cora Mae Wilson is a native of Brinkley, Arkansas. It is where she raised her eight children and where every line of this family begins.

history.title: Eight children in thirteen years
history.body: Joanne (1955), Marietha (1957), Renae (1960), Derrick (1961), Anthony (1963), Tammie (1964), Tanya (1966), and Darwin (1968) were all born in Brinkley. Every one of them graduated from Brinkley High School.

history.title: A family of service
history.body: Renae served four years in the US Army, Derrick four years in the US Navy, Anthony six years in the Army beginning in 1981, and the next generation followed: Christopher in the Army and Bernard in the Air Force from 2012.

history.title: The family moves west
history.body: Several branches settled in the Pacific Northwest. Derrick, Anthony, Corey, Camren, Josh, and Bernard have all called Tacoma, Washington home, while Greg and Tanya built their lives in Jonesboro, Arkansas.
